title: Core Public Export Boundary Review Checklist

items.label: Inventory the current Core root entrypoint and classify which exports are consumer surface, internal evidence surface, or release-blocked surface.
items.evidenceTarget: Core `src/index.ts`, package exports, and Core-owned docs identify the present public entrypoint shape.

items.label: Inspect current Editor and Backend imports from `@flowdoc/vnext-core` before changing the Core package surface.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor and Backend import inventories show whether consumers rely on root exports, fixtures, or internals.

items.label: Define the smallest approved Core consumer surface or record an explicit no-go decision.
items.evidenceTarget: A Core-owned contract, test, or document names supported consumer modules and excluded internal modules.

items.label: Run Core plus affected consumer checks after any export boundary change or no-go record.
items.evidenceTarget: Fresh Core, Editor, and Backend checks prove the boundary decision does not silently break current consumers.

items.label: Return a bounded Project Control evidence candidate without promoting broader Core truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence candidate includes exact commit, path or contract ID, verification summary, and remaining unknowns.
